How to buy a house: Your step-by-step guide to buying in 2025
s: May 22, 2025 - There are five key factors that will help you – and your lender – determine if you’re ready to buy a house. Income and employment status: Lenders want to see stable incomes, preferably 2 years’ worth. You can prove this with your W-2s and tax returns. Also think about this for your own sake. A steady income is needed to cover long-term loan repayments. Debt-to-income ratio: Your DTI ratio shows lenders —and yourself — how much of your monthly income goes toward debt repayment.
